extraction.Name: George Haymond
extraction.Recorded patent: Yes, filed for record in 1918, Payne County, Okla.
extraction.Buyer: Land sold to C. E. Vandervoort, Sr. for $50,000.00 but money not delivered to allottee at time of sale
extraction.Occupation/Income: No income from any source. Shares in annuity to Pawnee Indians.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered Feb. 15, 1918, Agency Office; receipted for by allottee. Wife and three children dependent upon allottee. No property or money accumulated. Good health. Allottee feels he was forced to sell for $50,000 to settle a divorce suit then pending; had a buyer for $75,000 but attorneys advised him to sell for $50,000; allottee paid attorney fees for himself and wife costing $2,000.00. Notarized December 3, 1928, Pawnee County, Oklahoma; commission expires Jan. 31, 1929.
